summary: The change implements Object.setPrototypeOf in the order of the spec's six steps. Step 1 calls ops::require_object_coercible with ?. Step 2 throws a TypeError unless proto is an Object or null, and runs before step 3. Step 3 returns non-object obj unchanged. Step 4 calls [[SetPrototypeOf]] with ?. Step 5 throws a TypeError when the status is false. Step 6 returns obj. Each step keeps its spec comment above the code for it. The only remaining gap is Proxy [[SetPrototypeOf]], which the gate report shows failing with the engine's not-implemented error. That is an honest partial, not a defect. No special-casing, swallowed errors, or made-up values were found.
notes_for_next_attempt: No defects found in the diff. The remaining test262 failures (set-error.js) come from Proxy [[SetPrototypeOf]] being unimplemented, which throws the engine's not-implemented error. That belongs to the Proxy ticket, not this one.
